title: Untitled (Vertical CD Cascade)
description: Tall vertical collage featuring repeated compact discs, bullseye targets, and iridescent fragments arranged in stacked horizontal zones across a white ground. Gestural ink line drawings of abstract figures weave between photographic cutouts, ribbon stripes, and scattered holographic elements throughout the composition.
composition: stacked horizontal zones, vertical tall format
keywords: vertical panoramic collage with compact discs
